queries.title: test
queries.gherkin:
Given stocks from index nifty100
* stocks from list GILLETTE
When let close = latest in 1 samples of day close
Then list sads = tickers with close > 1000
queries.regex:
Given ^stocks from index (\w+(?:,*\s*\w*)*)$
* ^stocks from list (\w+(?:,*\s*\w*)*)$
When ^let (\w+) = (\w+) in (\d+) samples of (\w+) (\w+)$
Then ^list (\w+) = tickers with (.+)$

queries.gherkin:
Given stocks from index nifty100, nifty100lowvolatility30, nifty100quality30, nifty200, nifty200alp, nifty200moment, nifty200quali, nifty50, nifty500, nifty500multicap50, niftyauto, niftybank, niftycommodities, niftyconsumerdurables, niftycpse, niftyenergy, niftyfmcg, niftyindiadig, niftyindiamanufactu, niftyit, niftylargemidcap250, niftymedia, niftymetal, niftymicroca, niftymidcap100, niftymidcap150, niftymidcap150moment, niftymidcap150quality50, niftymidcap50, niftymidcapse, niftymidsmallcap400, niftymnc, niftynext50, niftyoilgas, niftypharma, niftypse, niftypsubank, niftyrealty, niftysmallcap100, niftysmallcap250, niftysmallcap50, niftytotalma
When let open = latest in 1 samples of day open
* let close = latest in 1 samples of day close
* let high = latest in 1 samples of day high
* let low = latest in 1 samples of day low
Then let condition = (close - open) / open 
* list upMovers = tickers with condition > 0.05
* list downMovers = tickers with condition < 0 and abs(condition) > 0.05
* let dayLength = high - low
* list hammer = tickers with close - low > 0.6 * dayLength and open - low > 0.6 * dayLength
* list invertedHammer = tickers with abs(high - close) > 0.6 * dayLength and abs(high - open) > 0.6 * dayLength

queries.gherkin:

When let ema10Min = minimum in 10 samples of day close ema 10
* let ema20Min = minimum in 10 samples of day close ema 20
* let ema10Max = maximum in 10 samples of day close ema 10
* let ema20Max = maximum in 10 samples of day close ema 20
* let ema10Change = change in 10 samples of day close ema 10
* let ema20Change = change in 10 samples of day close ema 20
Then let hasCross = ema10Min < ema20Min and ema10Max > ema20Max
* let isUp = ema10Change > 0.04 and ema20Change > 0.02
* let isDown = ema10Change < 0 and abs(ema10Change) > 0.02 and ema20Change < 0
* list upCross = tickers with hasCross and isUp
* list downCross = tickers with hasCross and isDown
